```{r}
# EM Algorithm for Mixture of Contaminated Normal Regressions (G = 2)
# Using random initialization

fit_mcn_reg_random <- function(x, y, G = 2, max_iter = 1000, tol = 1e-6) {
  n <- length(y)
  X <- cbind(1, x) # Design matrix for SLRM
  
  # --- 1. Random Initialization ---
  set.seed(123) # For reproducibility
  random_clusters <- sample(1:G, size = n, replace = TRUE)
  
  pi_g <- as.numeric(table(random_clusters) / n)
  beta <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = G)
  sigma2 <- rep(0, G)
  alpha <- rep(0.1, G) # Initialize 10% contamination
  eta <- rep(5.0, G)   # Initialize variance inflation
  
  for (g in 1:G) {
    idx <- which(random_clusters == g)
    if(length(idx) > 2) {
      mod <- lm(y[idx] ~ x[idx])
      beta[, g] <- coef(mod)
      sigma2[g] <- max(var(resid(mod)), 1e-6) 
    } else {
      beta[, g] <- c(mean(y), 0)
      sigma2[g] <- max(var(y), 1e-6) 
    }
  }
  
  ll_old <- -Inf
  iter <- 0
  
  # --- EM Loop ---
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    
    # --- E-Step ---
    dens_comp <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = G)
    v_hat <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = G)
    
    for (g in 1:G) {
      mu_g <- X %*% beta[, g]
      
      dens_good <- dnorm(y, mean = mu_g, sd = sqrt(sigma2[g]))
      dens_contam <- dnorm(y, mean = mu_g, sd = sqrt(eta[g] * sigma2[g]))
      
      dens_comp[, g] <- (1 - alpha[g]) * dens_good + alpha[g] * dens_contam
      v_hat[, g] <- ((1 - alpha[g]) * dens_good) / pmax(dens_comp[, g], 1e-16)
    }
    
    weighted_dens <- sweep(dens_comp, 2, pi_g, "*")
    total_dens <- rowSums(weighted_dens)
    z_hat <- sweep(weighted_dens, 1, total_dens, "/")
    
    ll_new <- sum(log(pmax(total_dens, 1e-16)))
    
    # --- Stopping Rule ---
    if (is.na(ll_new) || abs(ll_new - ll_old) < tol) {
      break
    }
    ll_old <- ll_new
    
    # --- M-Step ---
    n_g <- colSums(z_hat)
    pi_g <- n_g / n
    
    for (g in 1:G) {
      alpha[g] <- 1 - sum(z_hat[, g] * v_hat[, g]) / max(n_g[g], 1e-8)
      alpha[g] <- min(max(alpha[g], 1e-4), 0.9999) 
      
      w_ig <- z_hat[, g] * (v_hat[, g] + (1 - v_hat[, g]) / eta[g])
      W <- diag(w_ig)
      
      beta[, g] <- tryCatch({
        solve(t(X) %*% W %*% X) %*% t(X) %*% W %*% y
      }, error = function(e) beta[, g])
      
      mu_g <- X %*% beta[, g]
      resid2 <- (y - mu_g)^2
      
      sigma2[g] <- max(sum(w_ig * resid2) / max(n_g[g], 1e-8), 1e-6)
      
      num_eta <- sum(z_hat[, g] * (1 - v_hat[, g]) * resid2)
      den_eta <- sigma2[g] * sum(z_hat[, g] * (1 - v_hat[, g]))
      eta[g] <- max(num_eta / max(den_eta, 1e-8), 1.001) 
    }
  }
  
  # --- Results Output ---
  cat("--- EM Algorithm Converged ---\n")
  cat("Iterations:", iter, "\n")
  cat("Stopping Rule: Absolute change in Log-Likelihood <", tol, "\n")
  cat("Final Log-Likelihood:", ll_new, "\n\n")
  
  cat("--- Parameter Estimates ---\n")
  for(g in 1:G) {
    cat(sprintf("Component %d:\n", g))
    cat(sprintf("  pi (weight) : %.4f\n", pi_g[g]))
    cat(sprintf("  beta0 (int) : %.4f\n", beta[1, g]))
    cat(sprintf("  beta1 (slp) : %.4f\n", beta[2, g]))
    cat(sprintf("  sigma2      : %.4f\n", sigma2[g]))
    cat(sprintf("  alpha (out) : %.4f\n", alpha[g]))
    cat(sprintf("  eta (infl)  : %.4f\n\n", eta[g]))
  }
  
  return(list(pi = pi_g, beta = beta, sigma2 = sigma2, alpha = alpha, eta = eta, 
              ll = ll_new, iter = iter))
}

# Run the function on your corrected continuous data
res <- fit_mcn_reg_random(dat$x, dat$y, G = 2)
```

```{r}
# 1. Updated fitting function (Seed Removed)
fit_mcn_reg_random <- function(x, y, G = 2, max_iter = 1000, tol = 1e-6) {
  n <- length(y)
  X <- cbind(1, x) 
  
  # Random initialization without hardcoded seed
  random_clusters <- sample(1:G, size = n, replace = TRUE)
  
  pi_g <- as.numeric(table(random_clusters) / n)
  beta <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = G)
  sigma2 <- rep(0, G)
  alpha <- rep(0.1, G) 
  eta <- rep(5.0, G)   
  
  for (g in 1:G) {
    idx <- which(random_clusters == g)
    if(length(idx) > 2) {
      mod <- lm(y[idx] ~ x[idx])
      beta[, g] <- coef(mod)
      sigma2[g] <- max(var(resid(mod)), 1e-6) 
    } else {
      beta[, g] <- c(mean(y), 0)
      sigma2[g] <- max(var(y), 1e-6) 
    }
  }
  
  ll_old <- -Inf
  iter <- 0
  
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    dens_comp <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = G)
    v_hat <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = G)
    
    for (g in 1:G) {
      mu_g <- X %*% beta[, g]
      dens_good <- dnorm(y, mean = mu_g, sd = sqrt(sigma2[g]))
      dens_contam <- dnorm(y, mean = mu_g, sd = sqrt(eta[g] * sigma2[g]))
      
      dens_comp[, g] <- (1 - alpha[g]) * dens_good + alpha[g] * dens_contam
      v_hat[, g] <- ((1 - alpha[g]) * dens_good) / pmax(dens_comp[, g], 1e-16)
    }
    
    weighted_dens <- sweep(dens_comp, 2, pi_g, "*")
    total_dens <- rowSums(weighted_dens)
    z_hat <- sweep(weighted_dens, 1, total_dens, "/")
    
    ll_new <- sum(log(pmax(total_dens, 1e-16)))
    
    if (is.na(ll_new) || abs(ll_new - ll_old) < tol) {
      break
    }
    ll_old <- ll_new
    
    n_g <- colSums(z_hat)
    pi_g <- n_g / n
    
    for (g in 1:G) {
      alpha[g] <- 1 - sum(z_hat[, g] * v_hat[, g]) / max(n_g[g], 1e-8)
      alpha[g] <- min(max(alpha[g], 1e-4), 0.9999) 
      
      w_ig <- z_hat[, g] * (v_hat[, g] + (1 - v_hat[, g]) / eta[g])
      W <- diag(w_ig)
      
      beta[, g] <- tryCatch({
        solve(t(X) %*% W %*% X) %*% t(X) %*% W %*% y
      }, error = function(e) beta[, g])
      
      mu_g <- X %*% beta[, g]
      resid2 <- (y - mu_g)^2
      
      sigma2[g] <- max(sum(w_ig * resid2) / max(n_g[g], 1e-8), 1e-6)
      
      num_eta <- sum(z_hat[, g] * (1 - v_hat[, g]) * resid2)
      den_eta <- sigma2[g] * sum(z_hat[, g] * (1 - v_hat[, g]))
      eta[g] <- max(num_eta / max(den_eta, 1e-8), 1.001) 
    }
  }
  
  return(list(pi = pi_g, beta = beta, sigma2 = sigma2, alpha = alpha, eta = eta, ll = ll_new, iter = iter))
}

# 2. Wrapper function (Seed set here)
run_best_mcn <- function(x, y, G = 2, n_starts = 10) {
  
  best_res <- NULL
  best_ll <- -Inf
  
  # Set the seed ONCE outside the loop for reproducibility
  set.seed(42) 
  
  cat("Running", n_starts, "random initializations...\n")
  
  for (i in 1:n_starts) {
    res <- fit_mcn_reg_random(x, y, G = G, max_iter = 1000, tol = 1e-6)
    
    cat("Attempt", i, "- Log-Likelihood:", res$ll, "\n")
    
    if (!is.na(res$ll) && res$ll > best_ll) {
      best_ll <- res$ll
      best_res <- res
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n=== BEST MODEL SELECTED ===\n")
  cat("Best Log-Likelihood:", best_res$ll, "\n\n")
  
  cat("--- Parameter Estimates ---\n")
  for(g in 1:G) {
    cat(sprintf("Component %d:\n", g))
    cat(sprintf("  pi (weight) : %.4f\n", best_res$pi[g]))
    cat(sprintf("  beta0 (int) : %.4f\n", best_res$beta[1, g]))
    cat(sprintf("  beta1 (slp) : %.4f\n", best_res$beta[2, g]))
    cat(sprintf("  sigma2      : %.4f\n", best_res$sigma2[g]))
    cat(sprintf("  alpha (out) : %.4f\n", best_res$alpha[g]))
    cat(sprintf("  eta (infl)  : %.4f\n\n", best_res$eta[g]))
  }
  
  return(best_res)
}

# Run the fixed multi-start
best_model <- run_best_mcn(dat$x, dat$y, G = 2, n_starts = 10)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# 0. FORCE the environment to use the best model found by the multi-start loop
res <- best_model

# 1. Extract final parameters from the true global maximum
pi_g <- res$pi
beta <- res$beta
sigma2 <- res$sigma2
alpha <- res$alpha
eta <- res$eta

n <- nrow(dat)
X <- cbind(1, dat$x)
G <- 2

# 2. Recalculate Posteriors (E-step) at convergence
dens_comp <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = G)
v_hat <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = G)

for (g in 1:G) {
  mu_g <- X %*% beta[, g]
  dens_good <- dnorm(dat$y, mean = mu_g, sd = sqrt(sigma2[g]))
  dens_contam <- dnorm(dat$y, mean = mu_g, sd = sqrt(eta[g] * sigma2[g]))
  
  dens_comp[, g] <- (1 - alpha[g]) * dens_good + alpha[g] * dens_contam
  # v_hat is the probability of being "GOOD" data
  v_hat[, g] <- ((1 - alpha[g]) * dens_good) / pmax(dens_comp[, g], 1e-16)
}

weighted_dens <- sweep(dens_comp, 2, pi_g, "*")
total_dens <- rowSums(weighted_dens)
# z_hat is the probability of belonging to component g
z_hat <- sweep(weighted_dens, 1, total_dens, "/")

# 3. Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) Classification
# Assign to the component with the highest z_hat
comp_assignment <- max.col(z_hat)

# Classify as an outlier if v_hat (probability of being good) is < 0.5
is_outlier <- rep(FALSE, n)
for(i in 1:n) {
  g <- comp_assignment[i]
  if (v_hat[i, g] < 0.5) {
    is_outlier[i] <- TRUE
  }
}

# 4. Add classifications to the dataframe
dat$Cluster <- as.factor(comp_assignment)
dat$Status <- as.factor(ifelse(is_outlier, "Outlier", "Good Data"))

# 5. Plot the Data and Fitted Lines
p_fit <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cluster, shape = Status), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "royalblue", "2" = "firebrick")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Good Data" = 16, "Outlier" = 4)) + # 16=circle, 4=cross
  # Add fitted regression lines for both components using the global maximum betas
  geom_abline(intercept = beta[1,1], slope = beta[2,1], color = "royalblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(intercept = beta[1,2], slope = beta[2,2], color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Mixture of Contaminated Normal Regressions (G=2)",
       x = "Covariate (x)", y = "Response (y)",
       color = "Assigned Component", shape = "Observation Status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

print(p_fit)
ggsave("mcn_fitted_global_max.png", plot = p_fit, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Extract parameters
beta <- best_model$beta
pi_g <- best_model$pi
n <- nrow(dat)
X <- cbind(1, dat$x)

# 1. Get posterior probabilities (z_hat) from the best model
dens_comp <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = 2)
for (g in 1:2) {
  mu_g <- X %*% beta[, g]
  dens_good <- dnorm(dat$y, mean = mu_g, sd = sqrt(best_model$sigma2[g]))
  dens_contam <- dnorm(dat$y, mean = mu_g, sd = sqrt(best_model$eta[g] * best_model$sigma2[g]))
  dens_comp[, g] <- (1 - best_model$alpha[g]) * dens_good + best_model$alpha[g] * dens_contam
}
weighted_dens <- sweep(dens_comp, 2, pi_g, "*")
z_hat <- sweep(weighted_dens, 1, rowSums(weighted_dens), "/")

# 2. Calculate Total Sum of Squares (TSS)
y_bar <- mean(dat$y)
TSS <- sum((dat$y - y_bar)^2)

# 3. Calculate Weighted Sum of Squared Errors (WSSE)
WSSE <- 0
for (g in 1:2) {
  y_hat_g <- X %*% beta[, g]
  # Weight squared residuals by posterior membership probability
  WSSE <- WSSE + sum(z_hat[, g] * (dat$y - y_hat_g)^2)
}

# 4. Calculate Soft R-squared
R2_soft <- 1 - (WSSE / TSS)

cat("Soft R-squared:", round(R2_soft, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
# EM Algorithm for Contaminated Normal Cluster-Weighted Model (CN-CWM)
# G = 2, with robust bounding and multi-start

fit_cncwm_random <- function(x, y, G = 2, max_iter = 1000, tol = 1e-6) {
  n <- length(y)
  X_mat <- cbind(1, x)
  
  # Random initialization
  random_clusters <- sample(1:G, size = n, replace = TRUE)
  
  pi_g <- as.numeric(table(random_clusters) / n)
  
  # X-marginal parameters
  mu_x <- rep(0, G)
  sigma2_x <- rep(0, G)
  alpha_x <- rep(0.1, G)
  eta_x <- rep(5.0, G)
  
  # Y|X-conditional parameters
  beta <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = G)
  sigma2_y <- rep(0, G)
  alpha_y <- rep(0.1, G)
  eta_y <- rep(5.0, G)
  
  # Initialize based on random clusters
  for (g in 1:G) {
    idx <- which(random_clusters == g)
    if (length(idx) > 2) {
      mu_x[g] <- mean(x[idx])
      sigma2_x[g] <- max(var(x[idx]), 1e-4)
      
      mod <- lm(y[idx] ~ x[idx])
      beta[, g] <- coef(mod)
      sigma2_y[g] <- max(var(resid(mod)), 1e-4)
    } else {
      mu_x[g] <- mean(x)
      sigma2_x[g] <- max(var(x), 1e-4)
      beta[, g] <- c(mean(y), 0)
      sigma2_y[g] <- max(var(y), 1e-4)
    }
  }
  
  ll_old <- -Inf
  
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    
    # --- E-STEP ---
    dens_x <- matrix(0, n, G)
    dens_y <- matrix(0, n, G)
    joint_dens <- matrix(0, n, G)
    
    v_hat_x <- matrix(0, n, G)
    v_hat_y <- matrix(0, n, G)
    
    for (g in 1:G) {
      # 1. Marginal X densities
      dens_good_x <- dnorm(x, mean = mu_x[g], sd = sqrt(sigma2_x[g]))
      dens_cont_x <- dnorm(x, mean = mu_x[g], sd = sqrt(eta_x[g] * sigma2_x[g]))
      dens_x[, g] <- (1 - alpha_x[g]) * dens_good_x + alpha_x[g] * dens_cont_x
      
      v_hat_x[, g] <- ((1 - alpha_x[g]) * dens_good_x) / pmax(dens_x[, g], 1e-16)
      
      # 2. Conditional Y|X densities
      mu_yg <- X_mat %*% beta[, g]
      dens_good_y <- dnorm(y, mean = mu_yg, sd = sqrt(sigma2_y[g]))
      dens_cont_y <- dnorm(y, mean = mu_yg, sd = sqrt(eta_y[g] * sigma2_y[g]))
      dens_y[, g] <- (1 - alpha_y[g]) * dens_good_y + alpha_y[g] * dens_cont_y
      
      v_hat_y[, g] <- ((1 - alpha_y[g]) * dens_good_y) / pmax(dens_y[, g], 1e-16)
      
      # 3. Joint Density
      joint_dens[, g] <- dens_x[, g] * dens_y[, g]
    }
    
    weighted_joint <- sweep(joint_dens, 2, pi_g, "*")
    total_joint <- rowSums(weighted_joint)
    z_hat <- sweep(weighted_joint, 1, total_joint, "/")
    
    ll_new <- sum(log(pmax(total_joint, 1e-16)))
    
    # --- Stopping Rule ---
    if (is.na(ll_new) || abs(ll_new - ll_old) < tol) break
    ll_old <- ll_new
    
    # --- M-STEP ---
    n_g <- colSums(z_hat)
    pi_g <- n_g / n
    
    for (g in 1:G) {
      # --- Update X Marginal Parameters ---
      alpha_x[g] <- 1 - sum(z_hat[, g] * v_hat_x[, g]) / max(n_g[g], 1e-8)
      alpha_x[g] <- min(max(alpha_x[g], 1e-4), 0.9999)
      
      w_ig_x <- z_hat[, g] * (v_hat_x[, g] + (1 - v_hat_x[, g]) / eta_x[g])
      
      mu_x[g] <- sum(w_ig_x * x) / max(sum(w_ig_x), 1e-8)
      sigma2_x[g] <- max(sum(w_ig_x * (x - mu_x[g])^2) / max(n_g[g], 1e-8), 1e-6)
      
      num_eta_x <- sum(z_hat[, g] * (1 - v_hat_x[, g]) * (x - mu_x[g])^2)
      den_eta_x <- sigma2_x[g] * sum(z_hat[, g] * (1 - v_hat_x[, g]))
      eta_x[g] <- max(num_eta_x / max(den_eta_x, 1e-8), 1.001)
      
      # --- Update Y|X Conditional Parameters ---
      alpha_y[g] <- 1 - sum(z_hat[, g] * v_hat_y[, g]) / max(n_g[g], 1e-8)
      alpha_y[g] <- min(max(alpha_y[g], 1e-4), 0.9999)
      
      w_ig_y <- z_hat[, g] * (v_hat_y[, g] + (1 - v_hat_y[, g]) / eta_y[g])
      W_y <- diag(w_ig_y)
      
      beta[, g] <- tryCatch({
        solve(t(X_mat) %*% W_y %*% X_mat) %*% t(X_mat) %*% W_y %*% y
      }, error = function(e) beta[, g])
      
      mu_yg_new <- X_mat %*% beta[, g]
      resid2_y <- (y - mu_yg_new)^2
      
      sigma2_y[g] <- max(sum(w_ig_y * resid2_y) / max(n_g[g], 1e-8), 1e-6)
      
      num_eta_y <- sum(z_hat[, g] * (1 - v_hat_y[, g]) * resid2_y)
      den_eta_y <- sigma2_y[g] * sum(z_hat[, g] * (1 - v_hat_y[, g]))
      eta_y[g] <- max(num_eta_y / max(den_eta_y, 1e-8), 1.001)
    }
  }
  
  return(list(pi = pi_g, mu_x = mu_x, sigma2_x = sigma2_x, alpha_x = alpha_x, eta_x = eta_x,
              beta = beta, sigma2_y = sigma2_y, alpha_y = alpha_y, eta_y = eta_y, 
              ll = ll_new, iter = iter))
}

# Wrapper for Multi-Start CN-CWM
run_best_cncwm <- function(x, y, G = 2, n_starts = 10) {
  best_res <- NULL
  best_ll <- -Inf
  
  set.seed(42) # For reproducibility of random starts
  cat("Running", n_starts, "random initializations for CN-CWM...\n")
  
  for (i in 1:n_starts) {
    res <- fit_cncwm_random(x, y, G = G, max_iter = 1000, tol = 1e-6)
    cat("Attempt", i, "- Log-Likelihood:", res$ll, "\n")
    if (!is.na(res$ll) && res$ll > best_ll) {
      best_ll <- res$ll
      best_res <- res
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n=== BEST CN-CWM MODEL SELECTED ===\n")
  cat("Best Log-Likelihood:", best_res$ll, "\n\n")
  
  for(g in 1:G) {
    cat(sprintf("--- Component %d ---\n", g))
    cat(sprintf("Mixing Weight (pi) : %.4f\n", best_res$pi[g]))
    cat("  [X-Marginal]\n")
    cat(sprintf("    mu_x       : %.4f\n", best_res$mu_x[g]))
    cat(sprintf("    sigma2_x   : %.4f\n", best_res$sigma2_x[g]))
    cat(sprintf("    alpha_x    : %.4f\n", best_res$alpha_x[g]))
    cat(sprintf("    eta_x      : %.4f\n", best_res$eta_x[g]))
    cat("  [Y|X-Conditional]\n")
    cat(sprintf("    beta0 (int): %.4f\n", best_res$beta[1, g]))
    cat(sprintf("    beta1 (slp): %.4f\n", best_res$beta[2, g]))
    cat(sprintf("    sigma2_y   : %.4f\n", best_res$sigma2_y[g]))
    cat(sprintf("    alpha_y    : %.4f\n", best_res$alpha_y[g]))
    cat(sprintf("    eta_y      : %.4f\n\n", best_res$eta_y[g]))
  }
  return(best_res)
}

# Execute the fit
best_cncwm <- run_best_cncwm(dat$x, dat$y, G = 2, n_starts = 10)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# --- Ensure we are using the best CN-CWM model ---
res_cwm <- best_cncwm 
n <- nrow(dat)
X_mat <- cbind(1, dat$x)
G <- 2

# --- 1. Re-calculate Posteriors at Convergence ---
dens_x <- matrix(0, n, G)
dens_y <- matrix(0, n, G)
joint_dens <- matrix(0, n, G)
v_hat_x <- matrix(0, n, G)
v_hat_y <- matrix(0, n, G)

for (g in 1:G) {
  # X Marginal
  dens_good_x <- dnorm(dat$x, mean = res_cwm$mu_x[g], sd = sqrt(res_cwm$sigma2_x[g]))
  dens_cont_x <- dnorm(dat$x, mean = res_cwm$mu_x[g], sd = sqrt(res_cwm$eta_x[g] * res_cwm$sigma2_x[g]))
  dens_x[, g] <- (1 - res_cwm$alpha_x[g]) * dens_good_x + res_cwm$alpha_x[g] * dens_cont_x
  v_hat_x[, g] <- ((1 - res_cwm$alpha_x[g]) * dens_good_x) / pmax(dens_x[, g], 1e-16)
  
  # Y|X Conditional
  mu_yg <- X_mat %*% res_cwm$beta[, g]
  dens_good_y <- dnorm(dat$y, mean = mu_yg, sd = sqrt(res_cwm$sigma2_y[g]))
  dens_cont_y <- dnorm(dat$y, mean = mu_yg, sd = sqrt(res_cwm$eta_y[g] * res_cwm$sigma2_y[g]))
  dens_y[, g] <- (1 - res_cwm$alpha_y[g]) * dens_good_y + res_cwm$alpha_y[g] * dens_cont_y
  v_hat_y[, g] <- ((1 - res_cwm$alpha_y[g]) * dens_good_y) / pmax(dens_y[, g], 1e-16)
  
  joint_dens[, g] <- dens_x[, g] * dens_y[, g]
}

# Posterior component assignment (z_hat)
weighted_joint <- sweep(joint_dens, 2, res_cwm$pi, "*")
z_hat <- sweep(weighted_joint, 1, rowSums(weighted_joint), "/")
comp_assignment <- max.col(z_hat)

# --- 2. Classify Outliers and Leverage Points ---
# A point is a leverage point if v_hat_x < 0.5 in its assigned component
# A point is an outlier if v_hat_y < 0.5 in its assigned component
status <- rep("Good Data", n)
for(i in 1:n) {
  g <- comp_assignment[i]
  is_lev <- v_hat_x[i, g] < 0.5
  is_out <- v_hat_y[i, g] < 0.5
  
  if (is_lev && !is_out) status[i] <- "Leverage Point (Bad X)"
  if (!is_lev && is_out) status[i] <- "Vertical Outlier (Bad Y)"
  if (is_lev && is_out) status[i] <- "Both (Bad X & Y)"
}

dat$Cluster <- as.factor(comp_assignment)
dat$Status <- as.factor(status)

# --- 3. Plotting ---
p_cwm <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cluster, shape = Status), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "royalblue", "2" = "firebrick")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Good Data" = 16, 
                                "Leverage Point (Bad X)" = 17, # Triangle
                                "Vertical Outlier (Bad Y)" = 4, # Cross
                                "Both (Bad X & Y)" = 8)) + # Star
  geom_abline(intercept = res_cwm$beta[1,1], slope = res_cwm$beta[2,1], color = "royalblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(intercept = res_cwm$beta[1,2], slope = res_cwm$beta[2,2], color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Contaminated Normal Cluster-Weighted Model (CN-CWM)",
       x = "Covariate (x)", y = "Response (y)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

print(p_cwm)
ggsave("cncwm_fitted.png", plot = p_cwm, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# --- 4. Prediction at x = 0.5 ---
x_new <- 0.5
dens_x_new <- numeric(G)
for(g in 1:G) {
  dg_x <- dnorm(x_new, res_cwm$mu_x[g], sqrt(res_cwm$sigma2_x[g]))
  dc_x <- dnorm(x_new, res_cwm$mu_x[g], sqrt(res_cwm$eta_x[g] * res_cwm$sigma2_x[g]))
  dens_x_new[g] <- (1 - res_cwm$alpha_x[g]) * dg_x + res_cwm$alpha_x[g] * dc_x
}
# Component weights conditional on x=0.5
weighted_dens_x_new <- res_cwm$pi * dens_x_new
pi_g_given_x <- weighted_dens_x_new / sum(weighted_dens_x_new)

y_pred_1 <- res_cwm$beta[1,1] + res_cwm$beta[2,1] * x_new
y_pred_2 <- res_cwm$beta[1,2] + res_cwm$beta[2,2] * x_new
y_expected <- sum(pi_g_given_x * c(y_pred_1, y_pred_2))

cat("--- Prediction at x = 0.5 ---\n")
cat("pi_1(x=0.5):", pi_g_given_x[1], "\n")
cat("pi_2(x=0.5):", pi_g_given_x[2], "\n")
cat("E(Y | x=0.5):", y_expected, "\n\n")

# --- 5. Soft R-squared ---
y_bar <- mean(dat$y)
TSS <- sum((dat$y - y_bar)^2)
WSSE <- 0
for (g in 1:G) {
  y_hat_g <- X_mat %*% res_cwm$beta[, g]
  WSSE <- WSSE + sum(z_hat[, g] * (dat$y - y_hat_g)^2)
}
R2_soft <- 1 - (WSSE / TSS)
cat("Soft R-squared (CN-CWM):", R2_soft, "\n")

```
